# Drawlib Architecture

> Internal software architecture specification of Drawlib — layered drawing engine (l1–l4), AST caching, multi-target document compiler, CLI, and developer tooling.

## Overview

- [Architecture Overview](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/): Drawlib is a pure-Python library and toolset designed for "Illustration as Code" and "Illustrated Documentation as Code". Unlike traditional graphical…

- [Layer Hierarchy](https://www.drawlib.com/architecture/en/01_overview/02_layer_hierarchy.html): A drawing library faces severe architectural challenges: complex geometry transformations, stateful rendering backends, styling cascades, high-level layout…
